In [255]:
d=[]
for k in range(2,25):
    frog=KMeans(n_clusters=k,random_state=42)
    frog.fit_predict(x_scale)
    l=frog.labels_
    s=silhouette_score(x_scale,l)
    i=frog.inertia_
    print('for k =',k,' ','silhouette_score is ',s)
    print(frog.inertia_)
    d.append({'k':k,'inertia':round(i,2),'silhouette':s})
